foundationDeferrals.limits: Identity and radial release axes are supported by existing source evidence. The late dial-fastening chapter is an authored puzzle order, not certified assembly or servicing instructions.

dependencyEvidence.hostAndCoverConstraints: Existing independently checked host/cover pairs retained. Explicit internal hosts from source packet roles. See docs/PLAY_REDESIGN.md.
